title: Halting on a Short or Delimited Tail
statement: For either choice of the program parameter and every natural number $n$, if a bit string $t$ is empty, has length one, or begins with $10$, then there is a natural number $p$ such that, on input $t$, the program starting at its scan label with its single register equal to $n$ and input position $0$ reaches a halted state with the same register value and input position $p$, without adding any output, in at most three steps. This holds for every output string already printed.
hypotheses_covered: The program parameter is a Boolean choice
The tail is empty, has length one, or begins with $10$
The input position starts at zero
